# HZ Labs

> סטודיו פיתוח לבניית פלטפורמות תוכן, פורטלי לקוחות ומערכות מנויים — תל אביב, ישראל.

HZ Labs is a boutique software development studio based in Tel Aviv, Israel.
We design and build complex digital platforms for organizations and businesses:
content platforms, subscription systems, event management, unified admin dashboards,
and API integrations. Small team, personal approach, production-grade results.

## Services

- Full-stack web platform development (design → production)
- Content & media platforms with video streaming, live events, and tiered access
- Unified management dashboards connecting CRM, events, content, and payments
- Customer portals and subscription systems
- API integrations between existing tools and systems
- Ongoing development support and iteration

## Contact

- Website: https://harzahav.online
- Email: contact@hzlabs.io
- Location: Tel Aviv, Israel

## Technology

TypeScript, React, Node.js, Docker, nginx, REST & GraphQL APIs, Auth systems, CMS integrations.
